sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for evidence cards
sections.what: Brings in the state tool, the icons and the evidence type.
sections.why: Likely reason: each import supplies one part of the card list.

sections.name: EvidenceDisplayProps
sections.title: Input type for evidence list
sections.what: Declares that the component receives a list of evidence items.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes the expected input explicit.

sections.name: EvidenceDisplay (part 1)
sections.title: Open state and display helpers
sections.what: Keeps track of which cards are open and toggles one card when it is clicked. Chooses an icon colour from the file type and builds a location line from page, slide, sheet and chunk number.
sections.why: Likely reason: one shared open-state set lets the buttons open and close any card.
sections.watch_out: The starting open set holds only rank zero, so whether the first card opens depends on how ranks are numbered, which this code does not show.

sections.name: EvidenceDisplay: if
sections.title: Card header and empty check
sections.what: Draws nothing when there are no items. Otherwise draws the heading, the explanation and a clickable header for each item, showing rank, file name, location, date, relevance percentage and a SharePoint link.
sections.why: Likely reason: a clickable header keeps the list short until the owner wants details.
sections.watch_out: The SharePoint link stops the click from also opening or closing the card, so clicking the link leaves the card as it was.

sections.name: EvidenceDisplay (part 3)
sections.title: Expanded text and bulk buttons
sections.what: Shows the full passage text when a card is open, then draws Expand All and Collapse All buttons below the list.
sections.why: Likely reason: the full text is hidden by default to keep the list readable.
sections.watch_out: The passage text is shown as plain text, so any formatting in the document is lost.

summary: Shows the list of evidence passages behind an answer, as clickable cards that expand to show the full text.
purpose: Lets the owner read the exact passages the answer was built from.
why: Likely reason: showing the source text lets the owner check the answer personally.
how: Receives a list of evidence items and keeps track of which cards are open. Draws a heading and a short explanation, then one card per item with rank, file name, location, date, score and a SharePoint link. Opening a card shows its text. Expand All and Collapse All buttons sit at the bottom. If the list is empty, it draws nothing.
inputs: An array of evidence items, each with rank, file name, location, content, score, and optional date and link.
outputs: A list of cards on the page, or nothing when there are no items.
risks: The passage text is shown as plain text, so any formatting in the documents is lost. The starting open state assumes rank zero, which may not match the first rank shown. A date that cannot be read displays as invalid.
debug: If cards do not open, check that every item has a rank value. If the wrong card is open at the start, compare the starting value with the ranks the server returns. If percentages look wrong, check the score is between zero and one.
